change_chirho: Interface deadline 1200 to 2000 ms; tuning remains 1500 ms. Finished interface clips stay loaded despite late events. Ended-but-not-yet-paused clips free the knob channel. A deliberate request reloads a media-error clip but reuses one refused only by policy. No automatic retry.
ownership_chirho: Claude implemented six sound-lane paths and supplied stand-alone engine traces; root reviewed, reproduced old failures, ran integrated gates and owns publication.

gates_chirho.build_chirho: PASS through the normal external-first cache entry; licensed effects required in release inspection

root_negative_chirho.scope_chirho: The new slow-start and HTTP 503 manual-retry cases fail against the prior compiled application. A 1300 ms held response reproduces a source release at the old 1200 ms deadline, AbortError and no MediaError. Original failed records are retained.

peer_measured_chirho.method_chirho: Stand-alone bundled sound runtime and real prepared cuts; native media events, source MutationObserver, play outcome and server request log. Peer-executed traces retained privately and read back by root.
peer_measured_chirho.slow_start_chirho: Old 1.2 s deadline cuts the 1.0 s delayed response; fixed 2 s deadline reaches ended. A 2.6 s delay still releases at 2 s. Corrupt media reports error 4/NotSupportedError; policy refusal reports NotAllowedError without MediaError.
peer_measured_chirho.restart_chirho: All measured same-loaded-clip restarts reset ended and paused synchronously. Late events cannot finish a newer click. A knob step in the ended-before-paused window is accepted.
peer_measured_chirho.recovery_chirho: HTTP 503 followed by a healthy response plays after the next deliberate press in both engines; no automatic retry. Policy refusal keeps the loaded clip.

integrated_chirho: Six focused engine cases pass against the fixed compiled application, including real prepared effects, bounded delayed starts and a manual retry after HTTP 503. local_events_chirho.json separately records native On/3D/Off click completion with actual advancing publisher audio and the same media element.
limits_chirho: The historical public failure is consistent with the deadline mechanism; its own network timing was not retained, so its exact cause remains an inference.
Chromium may retain corrupt same-URL bytes in its in-page media cache after source reassignment; the app cannot guarantee recovery of that cached corruption.
The local Chromium 3D-toggle ended event was delivered after about 4.35 s during scene startup; it retained its source and reached native completion. These event times do not measure acoustic output.
Keyboard-before-On feedback remains outside this correction. No physical phone, Safari installation, acoustic, lock-screen or native/store acceptance is claimed.
